title: Why minor sad?
html_source:
There is debate about whether music in minor keys sounds sad compared to major keys due cultural tradition or parallels to speech patterns.
See http://www.nature.com/news/2010/100108/full/news.2010.3.html
“It’s possible even in the Western idiom to write happy minor-key music — Van Morrison’s ‘Moondance’, for example — or sad major-key music, such as Billie Holiday’s ‘No Good Man’.”
